title: Conv Layer Parameters
prompt:
A Conv2D has 7 input channels, 11 filters, and a 3×3 kernel (with a bias per filter).

How many learnable parameters does it have?
hint: each filter: C_in·K·K weights + 1 bias; times C_out filters
recap: A Conv2D with C_in channels, C_out filters and a K×K kernel has C_in·K·K weights + 1 bias per filter, times C_out: C_out·(C_in·K^2 + 1).
